about.title: About Me
about.bio_1: I'm a full-stack developer passionate about crafting digital experiences that blend aesthetics with functionality.
about.bio_2: From web frontends to low-level WASM, from interactive installations to educational games — I thrive at the intersection of technology and art.
about.bio_3: In my spare time, I enjoy listening to music, tinkering with Raspberry Pi, exploring networking, and occasionally making some tunes.
about.highlight_text: AI-driven interactive experiences, WebAssembly performance optimization, bespoke toolchain development
